name: KoTerminal
description: A real terminal in a KoBar panel: tabs, PowerShell, Command Prompt, Git Bash, WSL, zsh or bash, through a small local bridge that only listens on 127.0.0.1.
author: Ekrem EDALI
versionNote: New design for KoBar 1.5: redesigned terminal panel and settings; the bar tile shows how many terminals are open.
